user_evidence_html:
Who: a friend who is currently furnishing his living room tried Theia on his own room on 26 October 2026, using Facebook Marketplace listings he was considering.

  • What helped: seeing how listings looked next to the furniture he already owns, in his own room, was useful.
  • What frustrated him: items did not always scale correctly, and having to correct sizes by hand was frustrating. (This matches the scaling bugs found in testing, and the case where Facebook hid the seller's measurements.)
  • What he wants next: Theia plugged into, or overlaid on, Marketplace itself, so he could visualise items without switching between browser tabs.
  • Outcome: he said Theia made him more likely to buy something on Marketplace than before.

One user, informal session, paraphrased with his permission; no timing was recorded, so this report does not claim a time saving.
